meta.title: Implement simplified dynamic registry with DTD-driven tool discovery
meta.body_summary: Introduces a simplified event-driven dynamic tool registration system for Flutter MCP tools that uses DTD events and VM service connections, eliminating periodic polling and enabling immediate tool discovery.

perf_labels.notes: Cursor added DTD-based event-driven discovery replacing polling; coderabbitai suggested minor improvements but merge proceeded without requiring changes.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 1381 changed lines, this is a medium-sized feature addition by absolute volume. As a moderate incremental performance feature PR, it was merged quickly without blocking review.

review_details.concern_detail: CodeRabbit bot flagged isolate ID clearing, JSON parsing error handling, resource name extraction, and isolate fallback logic as potential improvements, but none were blocking.
review_details.performance_claim: Event-driven discovery with DTD eliminates periodic polling, providing immediate tool availability and reduced overhead.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Cursor delivered a substantial, working feature using Dart's DTD and VM service for event-driven tool discovery; no blocking review, merged quickly.

detection_detail.code_reading: CodeRabbit bot performed automated code review and made non-blocking suggestions; maintainer merged without manual performance verification.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR narrative claims performance improvement but lacks benchmarks or before/after metrics; maintainer did not request evidence.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regressions were reported or addressed; PR merged with only non-blocking bot suggestions.

core_change_summary.description: Added SimplifiedDiscoveryService for DTD-driven tool registration, AutomaticDiscoveryService for polling-based fallback, updated DynamicRegistry to forward tool calls via VM service extensions, and added example Fibonacci tool app and documentation.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Documentation, makefile, example, and mixins support the primary discovery services but don't directly change the performance path.
change_trajectory: Single commit (45b4b55) added all new discovery services, registry updates, documentation, and example.

review_signals.summary: CodeRabbit bot review raised 4 actionable non-blocking suggestions (isolate ID clearing, JSON parsing, resource name extraction, isolate fallback).
Generated a walkthrough, sequence diagram, and change table summarizing the PR.
Maintainer manually triggered another CodeRabbit review with '@coderabbitai review'.

collaboration_trajectory: Cursor agent committed the entire feature in a single commit.
CodeRabbit bot immediately posted a walkthrough summary and performed a formal review with nitpick suggestions.
Maintainer manually triggered another review, but no further changes were made.
Maintainer merged the PR shortly after, ~11 minutes from creation.
